reviews.text: Shawn came to our home and measured all of our hail damaged window screens.  In about a week he returned with all new exact copies of the original screens and installed them in about an hour. (17 screens) We also had two windows with problems that I could not figure out how to repair - he fixed them both in about 10 minutes.  He communicated very well about scheduling both visits and was punctual.  Shawn is a great guy to work with, and I highly recommend Advanced Window Solutions.

Shawn came by to help fix my existing window. After a long time trouble shooting, it couldn’t be saved but he didn’t even charge me for the time.
Ended up replacing with window anyways and he did a very high quality job. Would 100% recommend to anyone in the DFW area.  Absolute pleasure doing business with Shawn
I used this company to replace window screens at one of my customers houses and they did an amazing job communicating with the homeowner for me and got the job done quickly and professionally

I had a great experience working with Advance Window Solutions.

Shawn Calahan was very professional and we had a great collaboration with him. He responded promptly to my request to evaluate the broken window, communicated with us quickly both via email and phone, and was able to accommodate us very quickly on the calendar. He delivered the service in a very organized fashion and he was very clean and quiet. Very competitive pricing.
I totally recommend his service. Great job!

I've used Advanced Window Solutions to replace several of our windows and repair several screens. Shawn is awesome to work with! His pricing is competitive; he does careful, neat work; he's punctual; and on top of all that, he's extremely nice. I highly recommend Advanced Window Solutions!

Excellent service! Shawn takes the time to understand your needs- not quote you the most he thinks he can get from you. We highly recommend him. His prices have been reasonable and he’s willing to back up his installations with a warranty. He also taught me that my window cleaning service wasn’t doing their job and showed me the services they didn’t perform- that they should have. So glad we found him!
We've had Shawn replace multiple windows in our house.  He is always great to work with and very responsive.  Highly recommend you reach out to him before going to any other window person.

Shawn replaced the window screens for my house, the price is good and the product is good. He is efficient and honest, very professional. I will recommend Shawn to my friends, and advanced window will be my first choice for any future project.

We recently had Shawn replace the glasses and screens in most of our windows. He is an excellent person to work with. I have hardly seen anyone who is so focused on customer satisfaction, and who goes out of his way to ensure that the customer is so happy with the outcome of his work. He was assisted by his son for the work (and he has raised his son well - he is equally wonderful as his dad). I called Shaun at Advanced Window Solutions and he gladly came out the same day with a very reasonable quote. The window had to be ordered and when it came in, Shawn came out and installed the new one in. He made sure both of my windows not only looked good but functioned correctly before leaving. Someone from next door recommended Shawn and I'm thankful they did! He was honest in what needed to be done and took care of it at a great price.
